snippet.title: Deep Space Exploitation - Game Trailer - Alpha
snippet.description:
Deep Space Exploitation is a space mining game featuring 2D physics and a destructible environment. Set in the distant future where mining ship pilots are trapped working for uncaring corporations, you will have to improve your equipment, upgrade your ship, and master the asteroids if you want to survive and secure your future.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3656660/Deep_Space_Exploitation/
Itch.io: https://juhrjuhr.itch.io/deep-space-exploitation


Trailer Music: https://jdsherbert.itch.io/
